text: 1.Academic Requirements:Applicant should hold Bachelor's degree diploma or equivalent from recognized university 2.A full-time work experience of three years or longer (Three years or more working experience is expected of bachelors from recognized universities; or Five years or more working experience is expected of three-year college graduates from recognized universities; or Two years or more working experience is expected of master or doctoral degree holders from recognized universities.) 3.Proficiency in English
